Aurora Borealis, or Northern Lights, are seen in bursts of green, pink and yellow in Lyndhurst, Hampshire, England on Monday. An aurora is a natural light display in Earth's sky, predominantly observed in high-latitude regions around the Arctic and Antarctic. The terms northern lights (aurora borealis) and southern lights (aurora australis) are used in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres respectively. Auroras display dynamic patterns of radiant light that appear as curtains, rays, spirals or dynamic flickers covering the entire sky. -BBC PHOTO
